# Stillness

> Breathe with the light. Stillness is a private, few-minute reset in the browser: a light that swells and settles at a slowing pace, a sound that follows it, and a camera that stays on your device. Nothing to choose, nothing to score.

## How it works

- The light opens with cyclic sighing (two inhales, one long exhale), then glides to about six breaths a minute with a longer exhale: slow paced breathing is the best-supported way to lower arousal within minutes.
- With camera permission, on-device face and shoulder landmarks sense breathing, movement and facial tension so the pace adapts and the session can report what it observed. Raw frames never leave the device.
- Sound is generated locally: an ocean that rises with each inhale, a low ground tone and soft bells on each turn of the breath.

## Pages

- [Stillness](https://stillness.hyperdrift.io/): begin a reset
